topic: Guangzhou Planning and Natural Resources Bureau planning-publicity GIS markers for three Guangzhou data-centre sites

register.publisher: Guangzhou Planning and Natural Resources Bureau (广州市规划和自然资源局)
register.page: https://ghzyj.gz.gov.cn/JGG/xcweb/#/bmap (规划公示电子地图; linked from the bureau's 批前公示 and 批后公布 channels)
register.list_endpoint_used: https://ghzyj.gz.gov.cn/JGG/xcapi/ghgs/list?page=1&limit=10&notSl=1&publish_id=<publishId> (credential-free GET used by the page itself; returns one publicity record with an lnglat field)
register.coordinate_semantics: The page's own map code (local capture gz-xcweb-chunk-5d907bf4.js, sha256 19bc1e366b37ce62d2cd562b5ac29da6d180c54165bbc8960d23be49452e095f) draws each record at lng/lat with spatialReference wkid 4326 over Tianditu 'vec_c'/'cva_c' tiles and the Guangzhou Tianditu node, i.e. geographic CGCS2000 longitude/latitude, treated here as WGS84-equivalent (sub-metre difference). No positional accuracy is published and the marker semantics (centroid, label point or hand placement) are not documented. The basemap service key embedded in that code was not used or copied.
register.discovery_note: Records were found with the register's own project-name filter (itemName) and fetched individually by publish_id; no web search engine was used. Some unfiltered register pages captured during discovery list private homeowners' elevator retrofits; those names were not transcribed anywhere.

gcj02_check_method: For each selected marker the position it would have if the published value were a GCJ-02 web-map coordinate was computed offline with the standard published GCJ-02 forward formula inverted by fixed-point iteration (no network service). Esri World Imagery z16/z17 tiles (Web Mercator, unshifted) were mosaicked and both positions plotted. Qualitative check only; imagery dates are not stated.

candidates.selected_point_role: official register marker of the as-built verification of machine-room buildings A3 and A4 inside the ZSCN-D4-1 campus; campus marker, not a building footprint, parcel centroid or entrance
candidates.imagery_observation: Read directly as WGS84 the marker falls among the flat-roofed machine-room buildings of a walled campus east of the Yongjiu expressway and south-west of the KS2 road alignment, matching the register address (south of planned KS2 Road, east of Yongjiu Expressway); research buildings under construction lie immediately north. The GCJ-02 alternative falls about 611 m west-north-west at the expressway edge beside a residential block, not on a data-centre campus.

candidates.imagery_observation: Read directly as WGS84 the marker falls on the middle of three large rectangular halls stacked north-south on the west of a campus, with a taller building to the east, matching the verification sheet's layout (8-storey data-centre buildings 1#, 2#, 3# west; 14-storey office 4# and factory 5# east; Bohua Third Road south; Yongjiu Expressway east). The GCJ-02 alternative falls about 611 m west-north-west in wooded land between the two expressway corridors, with no campus buildings.

candidates.imagery_observation: Read directly as WGS84 the marker falls on an active building site south of the Guanzhou river channel and east of an existing industrial block, consistent with buildings 2#-4# permitted in 2024 and verified as built in August 2026 (the imagery predates completion). The GCJ-02 alternative falls about 629 m west-north-west in an orchard strip beside the expressway bridge, not on a building site.

limits: Markers are official register points with undocumented placement rules; spreads of 74-160 m among records for the same parcel show they are not surveyed building positions. No horizontal accuracy is claimed; decimal places are publication precision.
